rule.LOCAL: Use only a local hypothesis that survives chronological validation for this token.
rule.STRUCTURE: Respect validated H1 structure and record continuation hypotheses independently.
rule.FLOW: Require executed-flow control plus directional price response; volume alone is insufficient.
rule.ENTRY: Use the highest-evidence causal entry family; never backdate to the local extreme.
rule.HOLD: Treat isolated counter-flow as noise until evidence supports sustained control transfer.
rule.MFE_EXIT: Compare MFE recoil jointly with flow weakening, opposite response and structure.
rule.REENTRY: Require intact structure, observed correction and return of original efficient flow.
